title: My Incel Story (a desperate plea for incels)
summary: NH tells how puberty, Bell's palsy and steroid-induced weight gain turned a doted-upon child into a bullied, rejected teenager, then how a late growth spurt showed him that treatment depends on appearance and left him resentful and self-sabotaging. He argues incels are a product of a system that ostracises them, that bashing them reinforces the mentality, and urges incels to leave blackpill forums and drop the identity.
claims: As a cute, intelligent child he was adored and forgiven for anything; puberty brought acne, greasy skin, no height and lost status
At 11 he got Bell's palsy and was put on corticosteroids that made him gain weight fast, starting middle school short, fat and acned
He was bullied daily for about two years; adults stopped caring once he was unattractive and some joined in
A school director told him he was beaten up because of how he behaved, dressed and spoke, implying he deserved it
Society rejects those who don't fit in and then punishes them for the withdrawal that rejection causes
Around 15 he grew fast, gained muscle and lost the acne; girls who had mocked him flirted with him, proving to him that treatment is about appearance
Saying incels are rejected only for personality is a lie; years of bullying make a sunny disposition hard, and appearance changes treatment
No one wants to be an incel; it is a defence mechanism after years of mistreatment, and later female attention doesn't heal it
Self-image formed in childhood and adolescence persists; becoming attractive at 16 didn't give him confidence to act
Women are averse to desperation and the stigma of rejection, so incel traits repel them beyond looks
He cites only 18 people charged with incel-motivated crimes in the US since 2014, mostly for online threats, versus about 1,200 women killed by partners in 2020
Shared incel traits (neediness, clinginess, low confidence, poor social skills, lashing out, self-sabotage) come from shared experience
Calling every man with unpopular views an incel turns the word into a synonym for evil man and justifies ostracism
Incels are the sick, not the disease; the system producing them must be fixed, banning their spaces just spawns new ones
Modern capitalism sells desire by frustrating it (citing Michel Clouscard), worsening sexual misery for young men
Bashing incels gives them an enemy and reinforces the mentality
In college he was rejected 30+ times because he acted desperate and overly aggressive, unconsciously sabotaging so rejection was about his actions, not his self
Recovery began once he saw he had let his past extend into adulthood and made it a personality; the lack of online incel forums then saved him
Incels should stop visiting forums and blackpill YouTubers whose business model keeps them stuck
Incel identity is spite like Dostoevsky's underground man; salvation means reintegrating into society or becoming fine without its approval
